opening.text: I have pain in my back. It started a week ago, though I've been having back pain on and off. It's sharp and it's an 8 out of 10. I take ibuprofen. I'm a construction worker. I've had to strain in order to urinate, and sometimes I feel as if I haven't emptied my bladder fully.
